judge: The agent partially completed the task but with significant issues. It accessed SkyTrip's My Trips section but only saw upcoming trips (not past trips) and fabricated trip counts (claiming LAX had 3 trips, SEA had 2). The visible data shows single trips to JFK, SEA, ORD, HNL, LHR, and partially LAX. The agent correctly searched QuickChat for Seattle (finding Maya Patel) and Los Angeles/LAX (no matches), and correctly searched TasteRank for Los Angeles finding Holbox and Bestia. However, the identification of most-visited cities was based on fabricated data rather than actual past trip history, and the agent never accessed a dedicated past trips section.
